flowpilot_metrics.latency_definition: WAV buffer delivery through local transcription and formatting; excludes OS insertion and visible-text verification
flowpilot_metrics.wer_reference_note: Raw WER uses spoken reference; cleaned WER uses separately formatted reference. The values are not directly comparable as an improvement ratio.
flowpilot_metrics.memory_sampling_note: Four observed host Python processes before the base model was loaded; not steady-state FlowPilot RSS
flowpilot_metrics.network_egress: No non-loopback socket attempts in selected instrumented FlowPilot dictation paths; not a complete byte-count audit

wispr_flow_observed.cloud_dependency: Cloud speech processing described in vendor documentation; protocol not captured here

trials.spoken_ref: FlowPilot provides real-time local speech intelligence on Windows desktop without cloud dependency or telemetry. The application captures audio through low-latency hardware buffers, processes phonemes using a quantized neural network, and safely injects text directly into active foreground applications using native operating system APIs.
